picks.title: NVIDIA RTX Remix 1.6 Launches With DLSS 5, 6X Multi Frame Generation, Minecraft Java Edition Support, And More
picks.excerpt: NVIDIA's RTX Remix 1.6 adds DLSS 5, 6X Multi Frame Generation, and experimental Minecraft support enhancing modding tools and performance.
picks.rationale: A new version of the modding toolkit: remaster artists get DLSS 5 neural rendering and Minecraft Java support right in their pipeline. Kept as the one pick from the DLSS 5 cluster c0.

picks.title: Unity CLI Usage Data: What 200 Million Events Reveal
picks.excerpt: Unity CLI usage data from 200 million events: 98% of runs come from AI coding agents and automation. See the top commands, agents, and where it's used.
picks.rationale: First-party data showing that 98% of Unity CLI runs come from AI agents. It changes how teams should design their engine tooling and automation.

picks.title: Xbox follows in PlayStation's footsteps, introducing AMD FSR 4.1, targeting better graphics and performance on Series X/S
picks.excerpt: Xbox Series X and Series S are getting a new AI upscaling technology comparable to PlayStation's QSSR.
picks.rationale: A new platform-level AI upscaler on Xbox Series X/S. Studios targeting current-gen consoles now have to plan around it, as they did for PS5 QSSR.

picks.title: Of Course Pokémon's Been Pulled Into The AI Decompilation Frenzy
picks.rationale: AI-assisted decompiles have now reached Nintendo's most heavily guarded IP. This is a new project in the decomp wave, and the brief has covered each earlier project (Banjo, CTR, Bloodborne, Link's Awakening) as its own card.

picks.title: [기획] 격변의 '모딩' 생태계, 울타리 넓히는 게임 산업
picks.excerpt: AI 기술 발전으로 게임 모드 시장이 팽창하면서 모드린스는 AI 모드 등록을 제한했고, 넥서스 모드는 AI 활용도에 따른 태그 분류를 도입했다. 게임사들도 대응을 고심 중이다. 라이엇 게임즈는 10월 6일부터 외부 프로그램 접근을 차단했고, 블리자드는 월드 오브 워크래프트 애드온 기능을 제한했다. 반면 스타필드와 발더스 게이트3 등은 공식 모딩 도구를 도입했으며, 2025년 호그와트 레거시, 2026년 스토커2와 심즈4도 지원을 확대한다. Microsoft는 아샤 샤르마 CEO가 언급한 엑스박스 랩스를 통해 게임 재구성을 탐색 중이다. 이제 게임은 잘 만드는 것을 넘어 이용자가 쉽게 바꿀 수 있게 만드는 경쟁력이 중요해졌다.
picks.rationale: Korean-market view of AI-era modding policy: Modrinth's AI-mod restriction and Nexus Mods' AI-usage tags have not appeared in the brief before, and the piece contrasts them with studios opening official mod tools.
